normalization: Full raw RNA library CP10K; input integer counts, not assumed UMI for non-UMI studies.
limits: ILC/T/NK shared states are not doublet evidence.
HSPC-related priming does not define normal HSC/MPP or discrete GMP/MEP.
HB alone and PF4/PPBP alone do not establish whole-cell identity.
Numerical thresholds are project diagnostics, not author-validated universal gates.
control_semantics: Source-stratified positive-component B-naive/ASC context, not truth labels or unbiased abundance; only targets receive working annotation updates.
